snippet.title: Demon Bluff Announcement Trailer | offbrand games x Northernlion
snippet.description:
😈 Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522600/Demon_Bluff/ 

We're partnering with Northernlion to publish DEMON BLUFF - a single-player social deduction roguelike where THE CARDS LIE! 

Coming 2026, wishlist now + join the playtest to try it out today 😈

Wishlist link: https://demonbluff.gg 
Official Discord link: https://discord.gg/shGVFhjJMe 

----------------------------------

About the game:
Demon Bluff combines the tension of social deduction games with the replay value of a single-player roguelike deckbuilder.

Your goal is to investigate a corrupted village, gather information from each character, and piece together the truth to uncover and slay every demon in hiding.

----------------------------------
